posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
MV and MZ organise animation data and sprites differently.
This ought to work in MZ regardless of animation "type" (Effekseer/MV-style):
caethyril said:
You could try one of these in a Script command:
Clear All Animations:
JavaScript:
SceneManager._scene._spriteset?.removeAllAnimations();
Clear Character Animation:
JavaScript:
// MZ, stop all ongoing animations on the player
const spriteset = SceneManager._scene._spriteset;
if (spriteset) {
  spriteset._animationSprites.filter(
    s => s.targetObjects.includes($gamePlayer)
  ).forEach(
    s => spriteset.removeAnimation(s)
  );
}
This is for the player. You can replace
$gamePlayer
with
$gameMap.event(123)
to target map event 123 instead.
(These MZ examples are from the "Character Effects" section of the
MV / MZ Script Call List
.)
